title: Judging What We Cannot Solve: A Consequence-Based Approach for Oracle-Free Evaluation of Research-Level Math

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the probability that LLM-judges versus Consequence-Based Utility (CBU) assign above-average scores to human-written correct solutions (which are often terse and intuition-driven) compared to LLM-generated correct solutions (which tend to be verbose and use canonical formatting).

Conducting a qualitative error analysis on incorrect mathematical solutions that improperly received high scores from LLM-judges, specifically annotating the frequency of 'external references' (citing named results without derivation) to show how judges are misled by authority-like cues.
